data.name: funnel / open / trades / evaluations
data.shape: four independent PublicResult reads — value | none | unreadable, each on its own
data.source: app.readCompetitor.execute — a competitor whose trades will not load still shows their funnel

components.purpose: What someone doing better actually does: the funnel, the holdings, the closes, the evaluations — each read standing on its own.
components.current_implementation: max-w-3xl centered column, space-y-6, p-6, four sections plus the back link. States only the public projection and says the private reasoning is withheld by the platform, not missing.
constraints: Four reads render independently — reporting the whole page unreadable when three quarters answered is the worse lie.
Withheld and unread stay separate: the platform publishes no private reasoning by design (none), which must never render like a failed read (unreadable).

components.purpose: What an empty or unreadable section says, per section, so no branch renders blank and no failure speaks for a neighbour.
components.current_implementation: Shared helper: the empty sentence names its section; unreadable carries role=alert plus WhyNotLoaded with a per-section subject.
constraints: Each section fails on its own and says which read failed — one shared reassurance three sections up says nothing.
role=alert on the unreadable branch must survive.

components.purpose: How much it looks at versus how much it acts on — the difference between two agents with the same win rate.
components.current_implementation: One tokened card: evaluations → decisions → entered, the two skip counters labelled apart, execution split, rates beside their counts, the result line in font-medium, top coins.
constraints: The two skip counters the platform names alike are labelled apart and never summed.
A rate the platform did not measure renders 'not measured', never 0%.

components.purpose: What it is holding now — count and unrealized only, because the row shape has never been observed.
components.current_implementation: Count + unrealized P&L; when rows arrive they are declared unmodelled in a sentence rather than guessed at (see backlog: open-position-rows-are-unobserved).
constraints: Position rows are carried but never rendered until their shape is observed on a live one — an invented rendering is worse than a stated absence.

components.purpose: What it closed: the platform's own verdict per trade, never one derived from the figure.
components.current_implementation: Tokened cards: market, direction, net, the platform's win/loss verdict, close reason, entries/exits, ROE, leverage, conviction, duration. 'Showing N of M' when the platform holds more.
constraints: The win/loss verdict is the platform's — never derived from the P&L figure.
Truncation is stated ('Showing N of M'), never silent.

components.purpose: What it evaluated, every row linking to its detail — including rows whose detail may not be published.
components.current_implementation: Tokened cards: coin (linked), score against bar, terminal status, signal count, bias, read direction, source, the conflict sentence in words, timestamp.
constraints: Every row is offered, including ones whose detail the platform may not publish — hiding a link on a prediction guesses on the reader's behalf; the detail page says plainly when nothing is there.

components.current_implementation: Shared NotConnected component; treatment owned by DT-0006.

flows.name: Learn from a leader
steps: open an evaluation to see what it actually read

accessibility.notes: Per-section unreadable states carry role=alert. No client JS.
